@graph.name: Rivka Lipkovitz
@graph.description: I’m an undergraduate at MIT studying mathematics, computer science, and economics. I’m interested in causal inference, econometrics, and data science. Previously, I was at Proof School, a math-centric middle and high school in San Francisco. I also did a project measuring the impact of strict voter ID laws on turnout. You can read my research paper here. I’ve been fencing for eleven years. I spent five years fencing saber before deciding to switch to foil in 2019. I mostly practice foil now, but still occasionally dabble in epee and saber. I’m also a certified referee in all three weapons, with experience at the national level. In my free time, I enjoy solving Rubik’s cubes and making cool things with my 3D printer.
